_provenance.what: Pre-registered double-annotation subset for the SciQ corpus-defect census (docs/corpus_defect_audit.md section 6, step 2).
_provenance.spec_gap: Section 6 asks for 15 of the 33 without naming which 15, who the second annotator is, or whether the passes are blind. All three were closed by decision; see docs/ANNOTATION_GUIDE.md section 2.6.
_provenance.annotator_1: the existing hand-check in results/ex5_failure_audit/passage_overlap_handcheck.json -- produced in an earlier session by an LLM agent, single pass, before this guide existed. Declared as an LLM rater.
_provenance.blind: yes -- annotator 2 does not read corpus_defect_audit.md sections 3.1-3.2 or the hand-check artifact until their sheet is locked
_provenance.selection_rule: random.Random(20260904).sample(sorted(prior_labelled_ids), 15), where prior_labelled_ids are the 21 SciQ ids annotator 1 categorised
_provenance.why_not_random_over_all_33: only the items annotator 1 covered support a two-annotator comparison; the other 12 have no first verdict to compare against
_provenance.not_marked_in_sheet: deliberate -- an annotator who knows which rows are scored may work them harder, biasing kappa upward
_provenance.gate: none; KAPPA_GATE=0.70 is pre-registered for Task A (judge validation) only
